requested_scope: Every mathematical assertion in the pinned paper, including both Corollary 1 occurrences, intermediate results, appendices, displayed equations, remarks and background facts needed by the arguments.
coverage_policy: Candidate library modules do not establish source correspondence. Check every domain, quantifier, normalization, constant, convergence statement and uniformity claim.
A citation is provenance, not an axiom or a supplied proof witness. Prove the used mathematical claim or reuse a checked theorem.
Explicitly record source corrections and formal obstructions. Never silently mark a weakened or corrected statement as the literal printed result.
The 27 named results are only the initial inventory. Equations and unnumbered claims require a separate page-by-page audit before completeness can be asserted.

known_exact_comparison_gaps: Appendix A cutoff four versus the earlier cutoff eight: the new radius-six tail bound now gives the cutoff-four Neumann inverse, but root localization and all downstream printed constants still need exact review.
Theorem 4 requires leading coefficient 2^m; the earlier C*(top+lower) estimate does not certify that statement.
Lemma 8 requires leading 2^(-m) and the explicit low-action coefficient, not a generic uniform majorant.
The real-exponent Corollary 1 is verified. The dynamical Corollary 1 has the exact conditional action-conserving-family bound, but action conservation for every claimed KdV solution remains unproved.
